title: andira fraxinifolia var. rosea
intro: Andira fraxinifolia var. rosea, commonly known as Pau-Brasil, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pau-Brasil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as protecting against oxidative stress and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Pau-Brasil also include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help to reduce pain and prevent infections.
